resources.string: Test your speed, keep your rhythm, and chase your best score.
Learn the modes, rules, and correct targets.
Learn each mode’s rhythm and risks quickly.
Tap the red target that appears randomly for 30 seconds.
Each correct tap increases your score and moves the target.
You have 3 lives. Tapping outside the target costs a life.
The game ends when time runs out or you lose all lives.
Lock on and raise your score
The purest way to test your reflexes. A target appears on the screen and you must tap it before time runs out. Every correct tap increases your score, while the pace gets faster as you progress.
The target moves and gets faster over time.
The target no longer stays still. Catch the moving target, tap at the right moment, and keep up with the increasing speed. This mode challenges your eyes, hands, and reflexes together.
Not every target you see is the correct one. Find the real target and avoid the decoys. A wrong tap can end the game. This mode tests both your focus and reaction speed.
Different colors appear on the screen, but you must tap only the requested color. Follow the active color task and avoid wrong taps. Fast decision-making is the key.
